summary: Independent review found TASK-0071 acceptance criteria satisfied by the registered producer evidence and fresh verifier checks.

criteria.criterion: A new profile `profile/development-bounded` exists in `GoalOperationProfileRegistry` with real AgentDriver + relaxed budget + path whitelist (A-workflow files) + path blacklist (B kernel files), registered and retrievable.
criteria.notes: Verified profile/development-bounded is registered with REAL_BOUNDED_EXECUTOR_REF, relaxed PlanBudget, A-workflow write allowlist, and B-kernel write blacklist.

criteria.criterion: The filesystem.write capability gateway enforces the path blacklist: an attempt to write `evidence_gate.py` (a blacklisted B-kernel file) is rejected with audit trail, covered by a test.
criteria.notes: Verified LocalRuntimeGateway rejects blacklisted evidence_gate.py writes with path_blacklisted audit coverage.

criteria.criterion: The profile grants process.exec for `scripts/check.py` and successfully runs it from a development node, covered by a test.
criteria.notes: Verified process.exec allowlist includes scripts/check.py and the development node fixture executes the granted check.

criteria.criterion: `ahra goal start` accepts `--allow-development-agent`, injects CodexSDKDriver, and uses the development profile, covered by a CLI invocation test or fixture.
criteria.notes: Verified ahra goal start accepts --allow-development-agent and CLI construction injects CodexSDKDriver behind GoalOperationService.

criteria.criterion: A sample GoalExecutionRequest using this profile can write `alignment_stub.py` (whitelisted) but is rejected when attempting `evidence_gate.py` (blacklisted), end-to-end verified by fixture.
criteria.notes: Verified sample development GoalExecutionRequest succeeds for alignment_stub.py and fails closed for evidence_gate.py before driver execution.

criteria.criterion: The domain module imports no adapter/model/cloud dependency in the profile definition (lint passes).
criteria.notes: Verified profile definition stays in the domain service without importing the Codex SDK adapter; adapter import is isolated to the CLI opt-in path.

criteria.criterion: Unit tests, lint, and diff checks pass: `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.test_goal_operations -v` and `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B scripts\check.py --lint` green.
criteria.notes: Verifier reran target unit tests, node executor tests, scripts/check.py --lint, scripts/check.py --test, and git diff --check successfully.

criteria.criterion: Producer moves TASK-0071 only to review; EvidenceGate decides completion.
criteria.notes: Verified task state is review@2, producer actor is distinct from verifier, and producer did not mark the task completed.
